films.title: Saccharine
films.synopsis: Believing that music can keep them together, Monika, Ludmilla and Honza go through their last rehearsal before their next concert. However, discrepancies about the craft and showbusiness reveal the cracks in their sibling dynamic.

films.title: Kate & Sam
films.synopsis: What begins as a picnic by the Vltava ends beneath a bridge, where Sam gets exactly what he came for. Kate is left with the quiet that follows.

films.title: El Testamento Belmonte
films.synopsis: In the last days of a civil war, Liborio waits for the world to behave the way it does in the books he reads. It doesn’t. Only a bull, the one thing in his life with the weight of a story, seems to promise him an ending.

films.title: Bi-Presence
films.synopsis: An experience repeats in Han's dreams. As she witnesses a cinematic recreation of it, she discovers how an image can be forgotten but not lost.
films.credit: Director, Writer, Cinematographer, Sound Designer & Editor

films.title: Nocturno de Chopin
films.synopsis: Inspired by a poem by Alejandra Pizarnik, Shirley wanders a tango bar in search of the lover who deceived her. The music plays on, and the night doesn’t let her go.
films.credit: Director, Writer, Cinematographer, Sound Designer & Editor

films.title: A Skull for Kira
films.synopsis: To impress Kira, a fellow dog, Max, a pug, sets out to give her the skull of a dead animal. But the skull is vanishing, and as the day runs out, Max finds himself searching for something that time can’t take.
films.credit: Director, Writer, Cinematographer, Sound Designer & Editor

about.heading: About Marco
paragraphs: Marco Tellez-Alcocer is a Mexican film director and editor based in Prague, working across fiction and documentary, whose films follow how people carry memory and search for purpose.

The impulse for each of his films is an image, a single moment that arrives long before the story does. From there, his films are built as an accumulation of images in which the past, memory, and the search for purpose intersect.

He is completing an MFA in Directing at the Film and Television School of the Academy of Performing Arts (FAMU), where he is developing a short documentary built from family archival footage, and Friedmann Creek, a fiction short about doppelgängers and the way a person’s presence is felt by others.
